translations.web: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.
translations.bsb: But of late My people have risen up like an enemy: You strip off the splendid robe from unsuspecting passersby like men returning from battle.
translations.kjv: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
translations.asv: But of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye strip the robe from off the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
